helpModal.title: Custom Data Guide (Legacy Version; Some Details May Be Outdated)

privateSpace.label: Private data library:
privateSpace.text: These data belong only to your account and can be viewed or edited only after you log in.

mapRendering.label: Map display:
mapRendering.text: The system groups records by “Feature” and displays “Value” directly at each map location.

feature.label: Feature:
feature.text: Used for grouping and searching, for example “流 rime group”, “豪 rime”, or “Yesterday”.

value.label: Value:
value.text: The content actually displayed on the map, for example “iu”, “Tasty”, or “53”.

featureType.label: Initial/Final/Tone or Category:
featureType.text: A broad category for the data, such as Initial, Final, Tone Value, or Vocabulary.

location.label: Short Location Name:
location.text: The location name displayed on the map; use the name you normally use.

region.label: Region:
region.text: The region to which the location belongs; this may be one of your custom regions.

examples.middleChinese: Recommended use: add location data that are not yet included in the public maps or character lists.
examples.personalCorpus: When you know the reading or lexical form used at a location that is not yet covered by the site, you can add it here yourself.

customCollection.title: Build Your Own Dataset
customCollection.intro: When you want to organize fieldwork, vocabulary, place names, or any other mappable notes, you can think of the fields like this:

region.label: Region:
region.text: The region to which the location belongs; you may enter one of your own custom regions.

featureType.label: Initial/Final/Tone or Category:
featureType.text: Used for broad classification, such as “Vocabulary” or “2026 Fieldwork”.

feature.label: Feature:
feature.text: Treat this as the search key, for example “Yesterday”, “Play”, or “止 · 精 initial group · open”.

value.label: Value:
value.text: Treat this as the map label, for example “从日”, “嬲”, or “ei”.

manage.label: Manage All My Custom Data
manage.text: Manage, edit, delete, and search all the personal custom data you have submitted.

notes.scope: First enter the name of your dataset in the Region field. Later searches can then be limited to that dataset.
notes.display: "Value" is shown directly on the map, so it works well for pronunciations, lexical forms, scores, or short notes.

dailyUsage.title: Useful Beyond Dialect Research
dailyUsage.intro: The same system can also serve as a private personal map, such as a food map, saved-attractions map, or interview log.

connectors.locationToData: Then add labels to each location

region.label: Initial/Final/Tone or Category
region.text: Like a folder or project name

location.label: Location
location.text: Like a place or store name

value.label: Value
value.text: The text shown directly on the map

dailyUsage.result: For example, set the category to “My Food Map” and search for the feature “Rating”; the map will display your comments at each restaurant location.

mode.label: 1. Choose a mode:
mode.text: “Add Individually” is suitable for selecting precise coordinates, while “Add in Batch” is suitable for pasting multiple records from Excel or another table.

coordinates.label: 2. Get coordinates:
coordinates.text: In individual-entry mode, open the panel and click a position on the map to fill in its latitude and longitude automatically.

save.label: 3. Save:
save.text: After confirming that the fields are correct, submit the record to save it in your private data library.
